text:
jas: OK serious question — who is the Clipboard Cowboy and why is there a tiny felt cowboy hat on my clipboard this morning? :cowboy_hat_face:
ken: not me, but I nominate @elaine if we're voting
elaine: guilty? maybe. I was scared of a stapler coup. :sweat_smile:
maria: I voted for 'Salsa Sentinel' earlier, can we have both titles? :tada:
ken: stapler has been wearing hat since 9:12am, evidence attached (photo)
jas: photo? post it!
dev-bot: deployed sticker-bot v2 -> automatically tags new desk decor with nicknames :robot_face:
elaine: I left a note: "This hat protects the sacred clip." — Clipboard Cowboy
ken: poll: Best new lore: 1) Clipboard Cowboy 2) Salsa Sentinel 3) Hat of Staplerhood. react with :one:, :two:, :three:
maria: :one: from me, Clipboard Cowboy all the way.
jas: :three: for Hat of Staplerhood. Also made a tiny sheriff badge, where should I pin it?
elaine: on the coffee machine. It's the law. :sunglasses:
ken: Ok new tradition: every time someone finishes a PR, tiny hat moves to their desk for a day. @here
maria: love this. stamped 'Approved by Clipboard Cowboy' on next PR
jas: where's the karaoke badge? we need tiers. :microphone:
ken: pinned the hat to the stapler, it now has it's own spotify playlist: tiny-hats-playlist
elaine: petty bureaucracy but this is my favorite kind. :heart:
